title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten recurring Stevenson University traditions and campus rituals documented by the university, from opening-week connection to creative showcases and seasonal celebrations.

cards.title: Founder’s Day Talent Show
cards.subtitle: Stevenson University campus tradition
cards.notes: Watch university event listings for the Founder’s Day program, then attend the talent-show celebration with the Stevenson community.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale campus program tied to Stevenson’s annual Founder’s Day celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson Student Life and Leadership identifies the Annual Founder’s Day Talent Show as one of its large-scale campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Student Life and Leadership calendar for timing and attendance details.

cards.title: Frost Fest
cards.subtitle: Stevenson University campus tradition
cards.notes: Look for Frost Fest in Stevenson’s seasonal programming and confirm the current activity schedule before heading to campus.
cards.short_summary: A named seasonal event included among Stevenson’s campus traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s Student Life and Leadership page lists Frost Fest among campus events and traditions.
cards.access_notes: Event details and eligibility may vary by year; verify with Student Life and Leadership.

cards.title: Food Truck Rally
cards.subtitle: Stevenson University campus tradition
cards.notes: Check the event announcement for the participating vendors and location, then plan time to explore the once-a-year rally.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus gathering where area food trucks take over a Stevenson parking lot.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says its Food Truck Rally occurs once a year and brings area food-truck vendors to a campus parking lot.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases and vendor offerings vary; consult the current event announcement.

cards.title: Homecoming Bonfire
cards.subtitle: Stevenson University campus tradition
cards.notes: Follow the official Homecoming schedule and join the supervised community gathering for the bonfire, hot chocolate, and s’mores.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming gathering centered on a pallet bonfire and shared seasonal treats.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson describes the Homecoming Bonfire as a celebration for students, faculty, and staff with hot chocolate and s’mores.
cards.access_notes: Attend only through the university’s organized Homecoming programming and follow event staff directions.

cards.title: Rockland Blowout
cards.subtitle: Rockland anniversary celebration at Stevenson
cards.notes: Check spring campus programming for the Rockland Blowout and use the event details to learn the location and schedule.
cards.short_summary: A spring celebration marking the anniversary of Rockland’s opening.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says Student Life and Leadership hosts the Rockland Blowout in spring to honor Rockland’s purpose on the anniversary of its opening.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current spring event details with Student Life and Leadership.

cards.title: BSU Fashion Show
cards.subtitle: Black Student Union spring tradition
cards.notes: Look for the Black Student Union’s spring show announcement and attend the student-run presentation when it is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A student-run spring fashion show identified by Stevenson as a campus tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson identifies the BSU Fashion Show as a campus tradition held every spring and says the club is open to all students.
cards.access_notes: Check Black Student Union or Student Life communications for the current show date and entry details.

cards.title: Annual Fashion Show
cards.subtitle: Fashion Design senior collections
cards.notes: Find the current Annual Fashion Show announcement and attend to see Fashion Design majors present their senior collections.
cards.short_summary: A hallmark Stevenson experience featuring Fashion Design seniors’ collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson calls its Annual Fashion Show a hallmark community experience featuring Fashion Design majors’ senior collections.
cards.access_notes: Program venue, ticketing, and access details should be verified for the current academic year.

cards.title: 72-Hour Film Festival
cards.subtitle: Student-made short-film showcase
cards.notes: Watch Film & Moving Image and arts announcements for the festival, then catch the review of student-created short films.
cards.short_summary: An annual-style campus film ritual built around shorts made by students across Stevenson.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says its student-run 72-Hour Film Festival reviews short films created by students across campus each year.
cards.access_notes: Confirm screening date, venue, and attendance information through current university arts communications.

cards.title: Wet and Wild Field Day
cards.subtitle: Annual Stevenson student event
cards.notes: Check the current student welcome information for Wet and Wild Field Day, and follow posted guidance on time, location, and participation.
cards.short_summary: A popular annual Stevenson event highlighted for incoming students.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s Fall 2026 Freshman Welcome Guide lists Wet and Wild Field Day among popular annual events students can anticipate.
cards.access_notes: Use the current welcome guide or Student Life communications because event logistics can change.

cards.entity_name: Welcome Week and Student Life Orientation
cards.title: Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: New-student Stevenson welcome ritual
cards.notes: New students should save the listed dates, review their assigned Orientation Leader information, and attend the scheduled sessions.
cards.short_summary: A required new-student welcome program designed to connect incoming students with one another and campus resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states that Welcome Week and Student Life Orientation is required for new students and assigns each student a peer Orientation Leader and group.
cards.access_notes: For Fall 2026, Stevenson lists Welcome Week as August 20–23; incoming students receive Orientation Leader information by email.
